blocks.raw:
<Tip>
**Parametric design = change parameters, the entire design updates automatically.** This is not hand-sketching or iterative drawing—it is algorithmic. Every surface, opening, and element derives from explicit parameters and relationships. This is how contemporary computational architecture works.
</Tip>

blocks.raw:
<Note>
Parametric complexity is not arbitrary—it is systematic. Every variation responds to specified parameters and constraints. This is fundamentally different from Deconstructivism's intentional instability. Parametricism claims logical coherence; Deconstructivism celebrates contradiction. Understand the philosophical difference.
</Note>

blocks.raw:
<Warn>
Parametricism is not just an elite avant-garde movement—it is now standard architectural practice. BIM and parametric tools are used in mainstream offices worldwide, from housing to infrastructure. Students sometimes treat Parametricism as experimental; in reality, it is the dominant methodology of contemporary professional practice. Know that the cutting edge has become routine.
</Warn>
